findings.message: "Retail buzz?" is anti-predictive (-13pt win delta, n=224) but still appears in decision logic — verify it isn't gating trades.
Cohort 'alerted=False' wins 12.5% vs 40.6% overall (n=40) — materially worse than the book.
"Reward:risk worth it?" is anti-predictive (-26pt, n=978). Not gating anything — fine as a model feature, but don't surface it as a quality badge.
"Worth the risk?" is anti-predictive (-26pt, n=991). Not gating anything — fine as a model feature, but don't surface it as a quality badge.
"With the market?" is anti-predictive (-16pt, n=991). Not gating anything — fine as a model feature, but don't surface it as a quality badge.
"Sector trending right?" is anti-predictive (-10pt, n=978). Not gating anything — fine as a model feature, but don't surface it as a quality badge.
Conviction tiers remain inverted: High 40.0% vs Medium 54.0% win. Any gate keyed on High is selecting the worse cohort.
Conviction referenced only as a pre-model fallback (guarded by a P(win) check) — acceptable.
13 of 71 installed skills are wired into the engine. 22 unused ones look trading-relevant — tested capability going spare.
